profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Suites team at iZotope, Inc.
profile.summary:
● 20 years of experience with C/C++ software development of video and audio editing applications on Windows and Macintosh
● Object-oriented design methodologies, client/host plugin architectures, COM interfaces
● Team player motivated by collaborative environments, with track record of mentoring less experienced developers
● Quick, enthusiastic learner when jumping onto new technologies
● Extensive experience building and debugging large, complex software solutions
● Windows, Mac OS X, Developer Studio, Xcode, AccuRev, ClearCase, scripting
● Very comfortable with scrum, Jira, and agile methodologies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Suites team
positions.description: ● Developing audio plugins and applications for the post-production and music industries, including mixing, mastering, restoration, and creative products

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Media Access team
positions.description:
● Participated on a 10-person scrum team doing C++ development on flagship video and audio editing application to support Media Access plugins that provide video, audio, and ancillary data from a variety of media formats, using Avid's proprietary COM-style API
● Designed and implemented host-side support for multi-channel and interleaved audio export for a high-profile customer
● Designed and implemented persistent media database to track media imported through Media Access plugins
● Developed generic interface to export video and audio from host to plugins
● Implemented export functionality for DPX plugin
● Mentored offshore developers through design reviews and code reviews

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Audio Editing team
positions.description:
● Collaborated on the team that designed and implemented support for stereo, 5.1 surround, and 7.1 surround editing tracks in MediaComposer
● Was responsible for the design and major parts of implementation, including compositional structures, interoperability  data, UI elements, and modifications to the mixer
● Implemented a system to maintain sample-accuracy of edits for frame-rate mix-and-match editing in the application

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Video Editing team
positions.description:
● Designed compositional structures to handle frame-rate mix-and-match
● Designed and implemented mechanism for converting a fully edited sequence to another video frame rate
● Implemented a system to archive and restore media from videotape
● Participated in a wide range of functionality development, including timeline editing, pipe building, relinking

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Film Editing team
positions.description:
● Sole developer responsible for Film options on MediaComposer application, including film-specific behaviors of capture, playback, and edgecode metadata
● Designed and implemented an Avid product for telecine capture using VTR emulation over RS-422 serial protocol combined with video and audio capture
● Implemented relink by edgecode data
● Implemented support for third party reader of VITC data out of video streams

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Worked on the team building the Multia video terminal system
● Implemented full suite of UI settings to provide Windows control panel functionality
